translation: One day the waist suddenly ached; the waist had had pain and disease before, and after rubbing it healed after a long time; this was perhaps due to being drawn and moved, and I did not pay attention to it. After several days of soreness, pain followed, and I could hardly stand or walk; there was no way to deal with it, so I rubbed the jaw with all my strength to draw it. After half a day the great lump arrived; originally it rose on both left and right, but this time it rose in sequence, because it was too thick and large to travel side by side.
